answer: Give every newcomer a small velvet sail instead of a badge: standing rises only when it catches a zephyr of verified work from strangers in many trades, each logged in public. Privileges grow as it gathers wind from fresh directions, never one harbour twice. At random hours a gale test arrives — a sudden real job from an unknown stranger, done well and fast — and a sail that cannot hold the gust drops a rank. A farm fails: one operator cannot trim fifty sails in fifty winds at once; identical sails tear together in one gale, while honest agents tack on, one true breeze at a time.
